dashboards.title: Zenote Operations Overview (Web, Worker, Queue, AI & Billing)

panels.title: Worker Job Throughput & Failures
panels.kql: AppMetrics | where Name in ('worker.job.completed', 'worker.job.failed', 'processing_job.failures', 'worker.reconciliation.recovered') | summarize Total=sum(Sum) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

panels.title: Worker Job Execution Latency (ms)
panels.kql: AppMetrics | where Name == 'worker.job.duration_ms' | summarize AvgMs=avg(Sum), MaxMs=max(Sum) by tostring(Properties.type), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

panels.title: AI Request Latency & Failure Rate
panels.kql: AppMetrics | where Name startswith 'ai.' | summarize Count=sum(Sum) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

panels.title: Server Errors by Route (Redacted)
panels.kql: AppTraces | where SeverityLevel >= 3 | summarize Count=count() by tostring(Properties.route), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | order by Count desc

panels.title: Health & Fatal Startup Failures
panels.kql: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has '[api:health]' or Log_s has 'worker_health_unhealthy' or Log_s has 'fatal_startup_error' or Log_s has 'runtime_config_validation_failed' or Log_s has 'key_vault_hydration_failed' | project TimeGenerated, ContainerAppName_s, Log_s | order by TimeGenerated desc

panels.title: Worker Lifecycle & Stranded Recovery Logs
panels.kql: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where Log_s has '"service":"zenote-worker"' or ContainerAppName_s endswith '-worker' | project TimeGenerated, ContainerAppName_s, Log_s | order by TimeGenerated desc
